Cut answers cast no vote, and finished answers under 8k are right about 85 % of the time (about 140 of 164 per sample), so the vote rises toward pass@3 over the short answers: about 1.25 x the single-sample count of about 55.5 (42.7 % of 130). run-04/f2-m06 ties the vote's gain to the full RL dose's answer concentration, not to the cap, so the vote keeps RL's ratio of about 1.08 (221/200 on hard328): 55.5 x 1.08 = 60.
